SELECT m.campaign_id, m.user_id, m.user_no, u.user_nm, u.phone_Num, u.resident_Num, c.campaign_title, c.leader_pay, (CASE WHEN c.type_code = '01' THEN '경호' WHEN c.type_code = '02' THEN '진행' WHEN c.type_code = '03' THEN '수행' ELSE '' END) AS type_nm, (CASE WHEN m.status = '0' THEN '대기' WHEN m.status = '1' THEN '출근' WHEN m.status = '2' THEN '퇴근' WHEN m.status = '3' THEN '지각' WHEN m.status = '4' THEN '결근' WHEN m.status = '5' THEN '무단' WHEN m.status = '8' THEN '인솔자' -- camp_leader status 처리 필요 시 추가 WHEN m.status = '9' THEN '인솔자' -- camp_leader status 처리 필요 시 추가 ELSE '없음' END) AS status_nm, ph.reason_info, c.time_segment, m.apply_date, ph.amount, m.is_deleted, m.user_type -- 'USER' 또는 'LEADER' 구분이 필요할 때 사용 FROM ( /* 1. 일반 지원자 목록 */ SELECT campaign_id, user_id, id AS user_no, status, apply_date, time_segment, is_deleted, 'USER' AS user_type FROM user_campaign uc WHERE uc.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND DATE(uc.apply_date) = #{applyDate} AND uc.time_segment = #{timeSegment} AND is_deleted = 'N' UNION ALL /* 2. 인솔자(리더) 목록 */ SELECT cl.campaign_id, user_id, user_no, status, apply_date, c.time_segment, cl.is_deleted, 'LEADER' AS user_type FROM camp_leader cl left outer join campaign c on cl.campaign_id = c.CAMPAIGN_ID WHERE cl.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND DATE(cl.apply_date) = #{applyDate} AND c.time_segment = #{timeSegment} AND cl.is_deleted = 'N' ) m LEFT OUTER JOIN user u ON m.user_id = u.user_id LEFT OUTER JOIN campaign c ON m.campaign_id = c.campaign_id LEFT OUTER JOIN point_history ph ON m.campaign_id = ph.campaign_id AND m.user_id = ph.user_id AND ph.category = 'OVERPAY' AND ph.is_deleted = 'N'
